CreateUserRequest.description: A new user, created by an administrator.

email.description: The new account's email address. Must not be registered already.

password.description: The new account's password, at least 8 characters.

role.description: The account's role. Not case-sensitive. `user` when omitted.

id.description: The id the deleted user had.

refreshToken.description: A refresh token, to get a new access token when this one expires. Single-use.

token.description: The access token, a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Short-lived.

tokenType.description: The scheme to use for the token in the Authorization header.

LoginRequest.description: The credentials of the account to sign in to.

refreshToken.description: The new refresh token. The one that was sent no longer works: keep this one.

token.description: The new access token, a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

tokenType.description: The scheme to use for the token in the Authorization header.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: A refresh token, from a login or from a previous refresh.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token. Single-use: sending it uses it up.

UpdateUserRequest.description: The changes to make to a user. Only the fields sent are changed.

email.description: A new email address. Must not belong to another user.

enabled.description: False disables the account: it can no longer log in.

password.description: A new password. Blank or missing leaves the current one.

users.description: The users, in no particular order.

UserRegisterAck.description: The user that was just created.

UserSummaryDto.description: A user as seen from outside. Never carries the password.

createdAt.description: When the account was created, ISO 8601 with offset.

enabled.description: False when an administrator has disabled the account: it cannot log in.

UserUpdateAck.description: The user as it is after the update.

enabled.description: False when the account is disabled: it cannot log in.

bearerAuth.description: The access token from `/api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/refresh`. It is short-lived: renew it with the refresh token.

info.description: Sign-in, token renewal, the caller's own profile and user administration. Log in at `/api/auth/login`, then send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every answer is wrapped in the same envelope (`success`, `data`, `error`, ...).
info.title: Century Road - auth-service

401.description: No token, or an invalid or expired one. `error` is UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The caller is signed in but is not an administrator. `error` is ACCESS_DENIED.

post.description: The role defaults to `user`. The new account is enabled.

400.description: The request is not valid: a missing or malformed email, a password shorter than 8 characters, a role that is neither admin nor user. `error` is VALIDATION_ERROR.

401.description: No token, or an invalid or expired one. `error` is UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The caller is signed in but is not an administrator. `error` is ACCESS_DENIED.

409.description: That email is already registered. `error` is CONFLICT.

delete.description: Permanent: the account cannot be recovered.

parameters.name: id

200.description: The user was deleted; the answer carries its id.

401.description: No token, or an invalid or expired one. `error` is UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The caller is signed in but is not an administrator. `error` is ACCESS_DENIED.

404.description: No user has that id. `error` is NOT_FOUND.

Only the fields sent are changed. A blank or missing `password` leaves the current one, so
changing a role does not need a new password.

parameters.description: The user's id, a positive number.
parameters.name: id

400.description: The request is not valid. `error` is VALIDATION_ERROR.

401.description: No token, or an invalid or expired one. `error` is UNAUTHENTICATED.

403.description: The caller is signed in but is not an administrator. `error` is ACCESS_DENIED.

404.description: No user has that id. `error` is NOT_FOUND.

409.description: That email belongs to another user. `error` is CONFLICT.

post.description:
Returns an access token, a JWT to send afterwards as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and
a refresh token to renew it with.

Attempts are limited per caller and email: too many is a 429 with a `Retry-After` header.
A wrong email, a wrong password and a disabled account all answer the same 401, on purpose,
so the answer does not say which accounts exist.

400.description: Email or password missing. `error` is INVALID_REQUEST.

401.description: Email or password not correct, or the account is disabled. `error` is INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description:
Revokes the refresh token sent. The access token already issued is a signed JWT and cannot
be recalled: it stays valid until it expires.

400.description: The refresh token is missing. `error` is VALIDATION_ERROR.

post.summary: Sign out by revoking a refresh token

post.description:
Refresh tokens are single-use: the answer carries a new one, and the one just sent stops
working. Keep the new one for next time.

200.description: A new access token and a new refresh token.

400.description: The refresh token is missing. `error` is VALIDATION_ERROR.

401.description: The refresh token is unknown, expired or already used, or its user no longer exists. `error` is INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token

get.description:
Read from the database on every call, not from the token's claims, so a change an
administrator makes shows at once instead of when the token expires.

401.description: No token, or an invalid or expired one. `error` is UNAUTHENTICATED.

404.description: The account no longer exists. `error` is NOT_FOUND.
